name: Hisuian Goodra

abilities.name: Securely Sheltered
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon takes −80 damage from that attack.

flavor:
Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell.
It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and
run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

pokedex.text: NO. 0706 Shell Bunker Pokémon HT: 5'7" WT: 736.6 lbs.
